school: 卡斯蒂利亚'新君主制'（王权集权与国家构建）
historical_significance: 卡斯蒂利亚女王（1451-1504），'天主教双王'之一：以秘密婚姻联合阿拉贡王冠、以内战后十五年不间断的制度施工（圣兄弟会治安体系、货币财政改革、corregidor 王室市长制、宗教裁判所的司法集权）把一个被贵族撕裂的王国改造成近代欧洲第一台'新君主制'国家机器；以十年格拉纳达战争的资产负债表式经营完成收复失地运动的终章；以一纸敕令派遣哥伦布开启大西洋时代，并在次年推动《托尔德西里亚斯条约》锁定航海成果——一个女人的四项决定（联姻、加冕、战争、西航）共同画出了近代西班牙与拉丁美洲的版图
historical_significance_en: Queen of Castile (1451-1504), one of 'the Catholic Monarchs': through a secret marriage she united the crown of Aragon; through fifteen years of unbroken institutional construction after the civil war (the Santa Hermandad's system of order, monetary and fiscal reform, the corregidor system of royal magistrates, the judicial centralization of the Inquisition) she reforged a kingdom torn by nobles into early modern Europe's first machine of the 'New Monarchy'; through the balance-sheet conduct of the ten-year Granada war she brought the reconquista to its close; and with a single patent she commissioned Columbus, opening the Atlantic age, then pushed the Treaty of Tordesillas the next year to lock in its gains — four decisions of one woman (marriage, coronation, war, westward voyage) together drew the map of modern Spain and Latin America
unique_thinking: 伊莎贝拉的独特思维不在于任何单一领域的深度，而在于'把一切工具化的统摄力'：婚姻是并表方案、信仰是财政资产、战争是制度工场、继承是组合管理、遗诏是治理合同。她的每一项行动都同时 operating 在两个层面——眼前的事件层面与长远的制度层面；格拉纳达围城的同时她在改铸货币，哥伦布陈情的六年里她在备置条件而不是修补方案。她从不发明工具，只做最清醒的工具使用者：把许可倒序（既成事实）、把账本分立（王冠联合）、把符号入表（十字军什一税）、把条款咬合（遗诏）——四类操作在她手中反复出现，构成一套完整的'主权方法论'
unique_thinking_en: Isabella's distinctiveness lies not in depth in any single field but in a governing power of instrumentalization: marriage a consolidation plan, belief a fiscal asset, war an institutional workshop, succession a portfolio, the will a governance contract. Every one of her actions operated on two levels at once — the immediate event and the long-run institution; she reminted coinage during the siege of Granada, and through the six years of Columbus's petitions she stocked conditions rather than patching the plan. She invented no tools; she was their clearest user: inverting permission (the accomplished fact), separating ledgers (the union of crowns), placing symbols on the ledger (the crusade tithe), interlocking clauses (the will) — four operations recurring throughout her hand, composing a complete methodology of sovereignty
civilization_zh: 十五世纪下半叶的伊比利亚现场：1451年生于卡斯蒂利亚中部的马德里加尔——父王胡安二世早逝、异母兄恩里克四世在位，王廷被贵族派系撕成碎片；少女时代在阿雷瓦洛与塞戈维亚的冷宫式监护中度过，身边环绕着觊觛王位的贵族与摇摆的廷臣；1468年《托罗之约》承认其为阿斯图里亚斯女亲王，1469年十八岁力排众议与阿拉贡的斐迪南秘密成婚——一道诏书、一次乔装、一场没有王室祝福的婚礼，换来卡斯蒂利亚与阿拉贡两顶王冠的联合；1474年兄死，她在塞戈维亚圣米格尔广场顶着内战加冕为王——葡萄牙入侵、贵族叛乱、王国金币贬值同时压来；1476年创立圣兄弟会（Santa Hermandad）以城镇民兵恢复治安，1476-1478年托莱多与布尔戈斯的改革议会在货币、财政、司法上重建王国信用；1478年获教皇敕令设立卡斯蒂利亚宗教裁判所，1480年托莱多议会定型其组织；1482-1492年十年格拉纳达战争——亲临前线、以后勤与营地建造指挥战争；1492年攻克格拉纳达、驱逐犹太人、派遣哥伦布——同一年做成的三件改写世界史的事；晚年丧子丧媳（胡安王子与伊莎贝拉公主相继早逝、疯女胡安娜成为继承人），1504年在梅迪纳德尔坎波离世。她的一生是'在婚姻里做主权交易、在战争里做制度建设、在信仰里做政治清洗'的完整标本。
civilization_en: The Iberian scene of the later fifteenth century: born in 1451 at Madrigal de las Altas Torres in the heart of Castile — her father John II dead early, her half-brother Henry IV reigning, the court torn to shreds by noble factions; a girlhood spent under cold, guardianship-style custody at Arevalo and Segovia, ringed by nobles coveting the throne and wavering courtiers; the Concord of Toros in 1468 recognized her as Princess of Asturias, and in 1469, at eighteen, she defied every counsel to marry Ferdinand of Aragon in secret — a forged papal bull, a disguised journey, a wedding without royal blessing, traded for the union of the crowns of Castile and Aragon; in 1474, at her brother's death, she was crowned at Segovia's Plaza de San Miguel amid civil war — Portuguese invasion, noble rebellion and a debased coinage pressing in at once; in 1476 she founded the Santa Hermandad, a town militia restoring public order, and the reform Cortes of Toledo and Burgos (1476-78) rebuilt the kingdom's credit in coin, finance and justice; in 1478 a papal bull established the Castilian Inquisition, whose organization was fixed at the Cortes of Toledo in 1480; from 1482 to 1492 the ten-year Granada war — she went to the front in person and commanded through logistics and camp-building; in 1492 Granada fell, the Jews were expelled, and Columbus sailed — three world-history-changing acts completed in a single year; her later years were eaten by grief — Prince John and Princess Isabella died one after the other, mad Juana became heir — and she died at Medina del Campo in 1504. Her life is a complete specimen of 'sovereignty negotiated through marriage, institution built through war, and political cleansing enacted through faith.'
key_works: 1475年《塞戈维亚协约》(Concordia de Segovia)——王冠联合的治理设计
1476年圣兄弟会敕令——治安与动员的制度化
1476-1480年托莱多-布尔戈斯议会改革法令——货币、财政与裁判所
1492年《圣塔菲条款》与哥伦布敕令——大西洋窗口的裁决
1504年遗诏——继承、摄政与领地不可分割的条款治理
key_concepts: 既成事实（factum accompli）——先造成不可逆事实、后获制度追认
王冠联合而制度分立——同一指挥权、两本独立账本
制度先行——以服务管线（治安、货币、司法）而非威慑建立权威
资产负债表战争——以常年收入管道与资产化支出供养长期战争
机会窗口精算——条件备置×窗口监测×限时裁决
杠杆用人——风险岗位交给身家在局中的能臣，以审计替代出身审查
信仰经济学——符号资产入表，符号负债同入表
战争即建设——战时建制预设战后转化路径
王朝组合——多方向布点、可再行权、集中度条款对冲
遗诏条款治理——最坏情形的可执行条款互相咬合
